page.layout: One page of text (main column, centre-right); a narrow strip of faint, cropped text in the right margin belonging to the facing page (not transcribed as main text, mostly illegible); no other blocks. Running head at top; page number at top left.

main_text.p: item officium est: Cum igitur, & munia hæc (3. & 2.) & insignia illa (2. & 1.) Genii nostri involaverint subdolè, usurpent injustè, cum summis eorum, quos ducunt, opprobriis, periculis, damnis, deturbandi sunt competentium & legitimorum judicum sententiis & auctoritate ab injusta istorum insignium & officiorum possessione. Quam in rem, ego quidem mihi partes Accusatoris depošco; Amor Sapientiæ (sic enim decet) judicis officio fungetur: Assessores erunt, quotquot verè doctos, & verè candidos, nullisque velut opinionum muneribus corruptos, totos, totos, purus ille puræ Veritatis Amor incessit: Et hos quidem Assessores, Textus innuit; Paraphrasis autem (forte quod tales aliquos in humano cœtu, repertum iri diffideret) Cælum adiit, & inde divo judici (Amori-Sapientiæ) divos collegas adscivit: Nitorem, Ordinem, Can-

page.notes: Right margin: faint, cropped fragments of the facing page (e.g. "Quæst.", "Genii"), too incomplete to transcribe reliably. The word "depošco" should read "depo-sco" (printed as "deposco"); the long s rendered as s throughout. Possible printing irregularities ("totos, totos") left as printed.
